text:
devin: Heads up — I'm seeing a latency regression on the hotpath for the v2.3.5 rollout. Metric alert: p99 on short-seq requests jumped ~2x compared to baseline. Can someone run a quick microbench (1k samples) with seq=512 batch=8 on a stage node and paste p50/p95/p99?

anya: On it. Which commit/hash and exact command?

devin: Rollout is on commit 0b3f4a2. Command I used locally: `python infra/bench/run.py --model redwood-v2 --commit 0b3f4a2 --seq 512 --batch 8 --samples 1000 --target stage`

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout to stage started for redwood-v2 @ 2244990000 — gradual 10% -> 50%.

leo: ran the sample on stage-3 (g4). Raw: p50 17.9ms, p95 56.4ms, p99 128.1ms. Baseline (pinned v2.3.4) p95 ~28ms on the same infra.

sarah: throwing in logs — noticed incremental heap growth in runtime process around the same timeframe: `kubectl logs runtime-pod-3 -c runtime | grep -E \"kvcache|alloc\" -n | tail -n 20` shows repeated kvcache miss + small alloc bursts.

devin: thanks. Can someone run `perf record` / flamegraph on a hot request? Also tag any long traces: `tracer` id 0x7b9f in the logs.

anya: starting a bisect run now across kernels + runtime flags (fp16 vs int8 and batch combiner on/off). Will upload profiles to /tmp/bench-profiles.

perf-ci: perf-ci: quick regression scan finished: compared p95/p99 vs baseline — p95 +100% and p99 +120% for short sequences. Flagging as regression.

leo: repro note: seems specific to small batches with seq around 256-1024. Larger sequences (>2048) unaffected. Also saw CPU steal spikes during a few tails.

devin: given perf-ci and manual checks, propose we pause the rollout to stage and pin stage to v2.3.4. Vote: :+1: to hold and rollback stage; :thumbsup: to proceed (no hold). Please respond quickly.

anya: :+1: hold. I'll keep bisect running to find the offending change.

leo: :+1: hold. I'll start a kernel-alloc focused bisect with smaller sample size to speed up.

sarah: :+1: hold. I can revert the rollout on infra side if needed.

devin: thanks — holding. Devin triggering rollback now.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for redwood-v2 on stage at 2245007002 by devin. Reverting to v2.3.4.

perf-ci: perf-ci: post-rollback quick scan: p95/p99 back to baseline within noise. No immediate regressions.

devin: great. Next steps: anya/leo to share bisect artifacts + top flamegraphs in /shared/perf/2245006789. Ops/sarah please watch the next canary window and ping if any anomalies. We'll reopen rollout once we have a root cause and a verified patch.

anya: uploading profiles now, ETA ~12m.

leo: noted — I'll also instrument kvcache metrics at 1s granularity for the next run.

sarah: ops watching, will escalate if tail signals reappear.

devin: thanks all. Short, async check resolved for now. Will post a summary and RCA once bisect narrows it down. :white_check_mark:
